title: Darius Slayton: I didn't pay much attention to rumors I was on roster bubble

sources.name: Pro Football Talk
sources.title: Darius Slayton: I didn't pay much attention to rumors I was on roster bubble
sources.description: Prior to last Sunday's cutdown day, there were rumors about the roster security of a number of players around the league and Giants wide receiver Darius Slayton was on that list.
